published.source: Class worker regear and rotation round, 2026-10-23: 8% hit cap regear, talents and rotations re-searched (seeds 1 and 1000003, 20000 iterations, 120 / 180 / 300 s)

summary: The sub Holy twist build with Exorcism, for an Undead or Demon boss. Since the 2026-10-23 regear it has the same talents, gear and rotation as Level 60 (vs Undead).
advantage: Exorcism only works on Undead and Demons. Purifying Power 2 makes its cooldown a third shorter.
advantageShort: Exorcism only hits Undead and Demons. Purifying Power 2 makes its cooldown a third shorter.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Command at -3s, Seal of Righteousness at -1.5s so the first swing gets the Echo
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Righteousness whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Righteousness up, swap to Seal of Command in the last 1.5s before a swing at any mana, and back before the next swing (one swap per swing); Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Hammer of Wrath below 20% health, ahead of Holy Strike
Consecration last, while mana is at or above 20%
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Dragonfire Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Holy Wrath is left out: its 2s cast resets the swing and cost 6.8 at 180s.
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the weapon percent (client data). Unconfirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% at stake).
Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once (70425 tooltip). Counted twice it would be 46-51 DPS higher. At the proc spell's 0 it would be 53-59 lower.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization boosts Holy seal damage (Era sim choice, the client says Physical only). Without it: -11.
The Goblin Land Mine (autocast, about 2.3 a fight) costs 1 to 6 DPS here; kept because every preset carries explosives (standards 11).
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as paladin__level_60_sub_holy except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeUndead, as the class preset's encounter does.
